population.span: involving patients with both severe CAP and a high inflammatory response, defined by a level of C-reactive protein (CRP) >15 mg/dL on admission, as described in detail elsewhere[ ].

endpoint.span: In-hospital mortality was a secondary outcome and adverse events were assessed.

estimate.span: In-hospital mortality did not differ between the 2 groups (6 patients [10%] in the methylprednisolone group vs 9 patients [15%] in the placebo group; P = .37); the difference between groups was 5% (95% CI, -6% to 17%).

ci.span: In-hospital mortality did not differ between the 2 groups (6 patients [10%] in the methylprednisolone group vs 9 patients [15%] in the placebo group; P = .37); the difference between groups was 5% (95% CI, -6% to 17%).

treatment_strategy.span: Patients were randomized to receive either an intravenous bolus of 0.5 mg/kg per 12 hours of methylprednisolone (n = 61) or placebo (n = 59) for 5 days started within 36 hours of hospital admission.

follow_up.span: Adverse events and mortality were recorded during the hospital stay.

absent_reason: {"analysis_set":"The original abstract does not identify the analysis set for its mortality estimate. The full texts describe restricted post hoc populations; their ITT or per-protocol labels cannot establish the analysis set of the original abstract estimate."}
served_mismatch: The served mortality event counts match the original abstract. However, its reported effect and CI are an absolute difference, not an RR. The served intention-to-treat label is not explicitly linked to that estimate in the held sources.

candidate_rejections.why: Adjusted post hoc effects in a restricted antibiotic-combination population; these cannot replace the original trial's overall mortality result.

candidate_rejections.span: Corticosteroid treatment reduced the risk of treatment failure (odds ratio, 0.34 [95% CI, 0.14 to 0.87]; P = .02).

entry_population_matches_question.why: Hospitalised patients with severe CAP and high inflammation fall within the question's population; the registry confirms adult eligibility. The estimate's ITT status remains unverified.
